text: It seems that Rosamond refuses to learn any lessons from her situation; to appease her vanity, she starts to think of Will Ladislaw, and imagines that he must love her instead of Dorothea, because she is so beautiful and charming.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
text: As the travelers traverse the length of Utah, a Mormon missionary boards the train and proceeds to give all who will listen to him an odd lesson in Mormon history, practice, theory, and culture.
translations_chinese: 当旅行者们穿越犹他州时，一位摩门教传教士登上火车，开始向所有愿意倾听的人讲授一个关于摩门教历史、实践、理论和文化的奇特课程。
